questions.question_text: What is the Maximum Takeoff/Landing Weight (MTOW) in lbs?
questions.explanation: Maximum Takeoff/Landing Weight (MTOW) is the maximum weight at which the aircraft is certified to take off or land safely.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum baggage weight in lbs?
questions.explanation: The maximum baggage weight for this aircraft is 130 pounds.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum MSL altitude for take off in feet?
questions.explanation: The maximum Mean Sea Level (MSL) altitude for takeoff is 10,000 feet.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum MSL optimum altitude for cruise in feet?
questions.explanation: The maximum MSL optimum altitude for cruise is 17,500 feet.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum crosswind in knots?
questions.explanation: The maximum crosswind component for this aircraft is 20 knots.

questions.question_text: What is the minimum time to maximum thrust from zero in seconds?
questions.explanation: The minimum time to reach maximum thrust from zero is 3 seconds.

questions.question_text: What is the maximum Cylinder Head Temperature (CHT) in Fahrenheit?
questions.explanation: The maximum Cylinder Head Temperature (CHT) is 435 degrees Fahrenheit.

questions.question_text: What is the normal operating fuel capacity in gallons?
questions.explanation: The normal operating fuel capacity is 53 gallons.

questions.question_text: What is the useful load in lbs?
questions.explanation: The useful load is the maximum amount of weight that can be carried.

questions.question_text: What is the empty weight in lbs?
questions.explanation: Empty weight is the basic weight of the aircraft without fuel, cargo, or passengers.
